name: Modal
tagline: Serverless cloud for AI, ML, and data workloads
description: Modal is a serverless platform for running AI inference, training, batch jobs, and web endpoints from Python — no Docker, no Kubernetes. It provides instant access to GPUs, autoscaling, persistent volumes, and scheduled jobs. Popular for teams shipping custom AI features, fine-tuning loops, and high-throughput batch pipelines.
pricingDetails: Free: $30/month in compute. Starter: usage-based. Team: $250/month minimum + usage. Enterprise: custom.
